from pysat.solvers import RC2, Glucose3
from pysat.formula import WCNF, CNF
import itertools

V = 19
E = 28

def edge_var(u, v):
    if u > v:
        u, v = v, u
    return 1 + u * V + v

cnf = CNF()

# Girth >= 7
# No cycles of length 3, 4, 5, 6
print("Generating constraints...")
# Length 3
for c in itertools.combinations(range(V), 3):
    cnf.append([-edge_var(c[0], c[1]), -edge_var(c[1], c[2]), -edge_var(c[0], c[2])])

# Length 4
for c in itertools.combinations(range(V), 4):
    cnf.append([-edge_var(c[0], c[1]), -edge_var(c[1], c[2]), -edge_var(c[2], c[3]), -edge_var(c[0], c[3])])
    cnf.append([-edge_var(c[0], c[1]), -edge_var(c[1], c[3]), -edge_var(c[3], c[2]), -edge_var(c[0], c[2])])
    cnf.append([-edge_var(c[0], c[2]), -edge_var(c[2], c[1]), -edge_var(c[1], c[3]), -edge_var(c[0], c[3])])

# Length 5
for c in itertools.combinations(range(V), 5):
    for p in itertools.permutations(c[1:]):
        # To avoid duplicates, only consider permutations where p[0] < p[-1]
        if p[0] < p[-1]:
            path = [c[0]] + list(p)
            cnf.append([-edge_var(path[i], path[(i+1)%5]) for i in range(5)])

# Length 6
for c in itertools.combinations(range(V), 6):
    for p in itertools.permutations(c[1:]):
        if p[0] < p[-1]:
            path = [c[0]] + list(p)
            cnf.append([-edge_var(path[i], path[(i+1)%6]) for i in range(6)])

print("Constraints generated. Solving...")
from pysat.card import CardEnc
# At least 28 edges
edge_vars = [edge_var(i, j) for i in range(V) for j in range(i+1, V)]
cnf.extend(CardEnc.atleast(lits=edge_vars, bound=28, encoding=1))

solver = Glucose3()
solver.append_formula(cnf)
if solver.solve():
    print("SAT")
    model = solver.get_model()
    edges = []
    for i in range(V):
        for j in range(i+1, V):
            if model[edge_var(i, j) - 1] > 0:
                edges.append((i, j))
    print(edges)
else:
    print("UNSAT")
